title: ROOT-CAUSED 2026-08-06 (owner's volume-knob flash observation broke it open): the white screen is kernel fb BLANKING — the app draws into fb memory the blanked ST7735S panel does not show (blank state displays white with backlight on); a keypress unblanks the VT, hence 'draws on first key'. Proven by sysfs: echo 1/0 > /sys/class/graphics/fb0/blank reproduces/cures it live; identical-frame md5s made presents look absent earlier (bad inference, recorded so nobody repeats it). Keep the prior psk until the new one associates once, so a bad join never destroys a working credential. The alpine helper's exit-0=config-applied contract stays; the verdict layer is the poller's probe.
